sheets.title: 작업 개수형
sheets.emphasis: 그레이즈 개량형의 교체 장갑·노출 프레임·박스 어깨
sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original HEX BLADE wearable powered exosuit character design sheet, one of four distinct concepts.
Input images and their roles: Image 1 = official Bandai Graze Custom/Graze Kai neutral product photo, strong reference for shape; Image 2 = official Bandai Reginlaze Julietta normal version neutral product photo, strong reference for shape; Image 3 = Graze Custom action product photo, reference for armor articulation; Image 4 = Reginlaze Julietta action product photo, reference for shoulder/arm articulation; Image 5 = user's original HEX BLADE cream mech game image, continuity for cream/graphite industrial identity, orange visor and red blade plus painted cel-shading style ONLY. Do not recreate menus, logos, boxes, photo backgrounds, giant robot scale, companions, or reference character sheet layout.
Primary request: strongly study the actual attached Graze Custom and Reginlaze Julietta form language and reinterpret them as a 2.20m WEARABLE EXOSUIT around one 1.75m adult human. This is human directly wearing head, torso, arm and leg shells, NOT a mobile suit with seated cockpit, NOT a robot with pilot in chest. New authored design with visibly strong reference influence. Make the reference-specific armor/frame relationships prominent, not just palette: angular shoulder caps standing apart from torso, narrow functional midriff with visible dark frame, separate angular thigh/knee/shin shells, tapered wedge boots, subdued military industrial plates, compact visor helmet. No Gundam V-fin or two glowing superhero eyes. No rounded tank-like squat 3-head-tall mech.
Human-fit design: human's head physically INSIDE helmet, eyes behind visor; shoulders inside upper torso under shoulder caps; elbows and knees coincide with suit's elbow/knee pivots; human hands inside gauntlets and feet inside boots, toes and heels share direction; no oversized distant robot hands operated by little internal joysticks, no long mechanical legs below pilot's feet, no missing pelvis, no seat or cockpit. Moderate grounded human body proportions about 7 heads tall including helmet, robot total height 2.2m including sole lifts and protective clearances. Compact backpack only, not above helmet height. Flexible armored abdomen protects pilot belly and hip, external actuators bridge joints without taking human space. Make anatomy plausible as a concept rather than claimed real engineering.
Sheet style: professional polished Japanese anime mecha concept illustration, confident dark-violet technical linework, crisp planar cel paint, restrained worn industrial materials, warm light-paper backdrop with subtle construction grid. Fine mechanism details, large clean armor masses, reference-specific sharp construction. Sparse restrained mint section markers, no huge decorative title, no busy logo or marketing copy.
Composition: landscape 3:2 character concept sheet. Main neutral full-body 3/4 suit standing with lowered primary weapon occupies left ~38%, smaller full-body front and rear turnaround center ~25%, LARGE full-body SIDE cutaway on right ~25% clearly showing transparent orange full adult body correctly nested throughout helmet, pelvis, arms and boots. Small upper-right helmet close-up with human head ghost inside. Lower-right small rear clamshell open entry diagram and elbow or knee axis detail. Bottom small 3 action thumbnails with consistent suit armor and limb lengths. Use arrows to explain wearable entry closure and actuator axis, no absurd disembodied torso or tiny chest pilot. Include ONE compact front-view scale inset along lower center: standing adult human1.75m and upright suit2.20m on same baseline, HUMAN MUST BE 79.5% AS TALL AS SUIT (head level near suit neck/upper shoulder). Both in this inset with same orthographic scale. Do not add a decorative tiny person beside hero. Main hero has readable "2.2m" dimension sole to helmet top. Orthographic figure armor consistent with hero.
Readable exact short Korean text from variant only, plus common text: "HEX BLADE / EXOSUIT", "전고 2.2m", "사람 1.75m", "정면", "후면", "인체 정렬", "후면 개방". No paragraphs, no invented measurements or unsupported stats, no tiny filler language. Full figure and weapon tip visible, generous gutters, uncluttered annotations. All views depict the SAME concept.
Variant A / FIELD REBUILD: a practical field-rebuilt powered suit, HEAVILY Graze Custom biased (about three quarters Graze shape influence). Small wedge-like brow visor helmet with one short rear-offset antenna, a broad flattened faceted white shoulder cap on each side set apart from relatively slim exposed dark cylindrical shoulder pivots; TWO separate pale cream upper-chest plates leaving a small orange optical/energy indicator between, muted olive green angular hip and thigh shells, long sharply folded shin plates, compact wedge toe boots. Angular ivory/cream repair panels visibly bolt onto olive base frame, subtle mismatched panel seams, asymmetric little tool bracket only. Avoid massive round shoulder balls. Keep narrow but anatomically filled covered waist, no open hollow torso. Outside elbow and calf slim pistons. Backpack = squat pivoting paired assist-thruster packs derived from Graze rear verniers, small enough for human balance. Main hand holds one simple red-lit straight industrial sword, no rifle needed; the other free gauntlet makes wearable human hand obvious. Detail diagram highlights bolted interchangeable shoulder plate and aligned knee axis. Three actions = rear entry, work-ready squat, diagonal sword cut. Text exact: "A · 작업 개수형", "교체 장갑", "외부 프레임", "관절 보조", "착용 → 보조 구동 → 검격". Strong Graze head/shoulder/chest visual resemblance but wearable, not merely previous cream robot recolored.
